newsitem.title: USA: Astra acquires stakes in Algas, Poligas.
newsitem.headline: Astra acquires stakes in Algas, Poligas.

text.p: Argentine oil firm Astra CAPSA said Wednesday it acquired controlling stakes in Algas S.A. and Poligas Eujan S.A., both marketers of liquefied petroleum gas, for $75.4 million.
Astra described the deal as a "takeover" and said it now holds 95.4 percent of Algas and 89.1 percent of Poligas.
Algas and Poligas have combined annual sales of $52 million and have an estimated 13 percent market share for liquefied petroleum gas in Argentina, it said.
The deal also included a 25 percent stake in the CA-14 Angostura oil field in Tierra del Fuego.

The takeover takes effect on June 2 and an extraordinary balance sheet will be prepared on July 31 to establish the final price. There are other terms to the deal, which is said are typical for similar transactions.
Astra is controlled by Spain's Repsol.
